notes:
Types

  • Order $m\times n$: $m$ rows, $n$ columns. Number of matrices of order $m\times n$ with entries from $k$ values $= k^{mn}$.
  • Diagonal, scalar, identity $I$, zero matrix; upper/lower triangular.
  • Symmetric: $A' = A$; skew-symmetric: $A' = -A$ (diagonal entries zero). Any square $A = \tfrac12(A + A') + \tfrac12(A - A')$.

Operations

  • $AB$ exists when columns of $A$ = rows of $B$; $(m\times n)(n\times p) = m\times p$. $AB \ne BA$ in general; $AB = 0$ does not imply $A = 0$ or $B = 0$.
  • $(AB)' = B'A'$, $(A')' = A$, $(kA)' = kA'$, $(A+B)' = A' + B'$.
  • $(AB)^{-1} = B^{-1}A^{-1}$, $(A')^{-1} = (A^{-1})'$, $(A^{-1})^{-1} = A$.

Special matrices

  • Idempotent: $A^2 = A$. Nilpotent: $A^k = 0$. Involutory: $A^2 = I$. Orthogonal: $AA' = I$ (e.g. rotation matrix $\begin{pmatrix}\cos\theta & -\sin\theta\\ \sin\theta & \cos\theta\end{pmatrix}$, and $A(\alpha)A(\beta) = A(\alpha+\beta)$).
  • Diagonal matrix powers: $\text{diag}(a,b)^n = \text{diag}(a^n, b^n)$.

Inverse (2×2)

$A = \begin{pmatrix}a & b\\ c & d\end{pmatrix}$, $A^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{ad - bc}\begin{pmatrix}d & -b\\ -c & a\end{pmatrix}$. Exists iff $|A| \ne 0$.

Adjoint & determinant facts (for $n\times n$)

  • $A(\text{adj}A) = (\text{adj}A)A = |A|I$; $|\text{adj}A| = |A|^{n-1}$; $|kA| = k^n|A|$; $|A^{-1}| = 1/|A|$; $|AB| = |A||B|$; $|A'| = |A|$.
  • $\text{adj}(AB) = \text{adj}B\cdot\text{adj}A$; $\text{adj}(\text{adj}A) = |A|^{n-2}A$.

Exam tip

2 questions: usually a property (transpose/inverse of product, $|\text{adj}A|$), or a short computation with a 2×2 matrix. Learn the rotation matrix and $A^n$ patterns.
